personal_info.about:
Hello! I'm Sravan, an enthusiastic MCA student passionate about exploring the world of software development, data science, and artificial intelligence. I love solving problems, learning new technologies, and creating impactful solutions that make life easier.
I am currently pursuing my Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at BVC College, with a strong interest in building a career in the IT industry. My academic journey has equipped me with a solid foundation in programming, algorithms, and emerging technologies.
My goal is to work in a challenging environment where I can apply my skills, grow professionally, and contribute to innovative projects.
